title: Revision of Threshold for Cash Transaction Reports

paragraphs.text: Reference is invited to paragraph 3 of circular GZ-AML-2019-01 dated November 5, 2019, which prescribes the threshold for Cash Transaction Reports. On a review, it has been decided to lower the reporting threshold for Cash Transaction Reports so as to capture a larger share of high-value cash activity.

With effect from October 1, 2021, paragraph 3 of circular GZ-AML-2019-01 dated November 5, 2019 on the threshold for Cash Transaction Reports stands substituted by the text set out in paragraph 3 of this circular, which shall thereafter be read as paragraph 3 of circular GZ-AML-2019-01.

The threshold for Cash Transaction Reports shall be Rs 8 lakh: all cash transactions of Rs 8 lakh and above, or its equivalent in foreign currency, and all series of integrally connected cash transactions aggregating Rs 8 lakh or more within a calendar month, shall be reported.

The filing deadline for Cash Transaction Reports remains unchanged: the Cash Transaction Report for each calendar month shall continue to be furnished to the Financial Intelligence Unit on or before the 15th day of the succeeding month, as provided in paragraph 4 of circular GZ-AML-2019-01.

Cash Transaction Report transition: cash transactions undertaken in the month of September 2021 shall be reported in the Cash Transaction Report due on October 15, 2021, applying the Cash Transaction Report threshold of Rs 10 lakh.

Cash Transaction Report transition: cash transactions undertaken in the month of October 2021 shall be reported in the Cash Transaction Report due on November 15, 2021, applying the Cash Transaction Report threshold of Rs 8 lakh.
